faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know before getting started.
faq.q1: Which languages does the platform support?
faq.a1: English, Arabic, Urdu, and Hindi today, with full right-to-left support for Arabic and Urdu — more languages are on the roadmap.
faq.q2: Do I need to replace my existing tools?
faq.a2: No. AutoMind AI is designed to be your dealership's operating system, but it fits around marketplaces and tools you already use.
faq.q3: Which AI models power the platform?
faq.a3: AutoMind AI is built on a provider-agnostic AI layer, so your dealership benefits from the best available models without being locked to one provider.
faq.q4: Can I try it before committing?
faq.a4: Yes — start a free demo instantly, no credit card or setup required.
faq.q5: Is this built for UAE dealerships specifically?
faq.a5: AutoMind AI is built UAE-first — GCC/UAE specification fields, all seven emirates, and RTA-ready registration data — while remaining ready to scale internationally.
faq.a6: Independent dealers, multi-branch groups, and brokers who want AI woven into every part of buying, selling, and managing vehicles.
